title: Global PIQA: Evaluating Physical Commonsense Reasoning Across 100+ Languages and Cultures
reasoning: The Global PIQA benchmark specifically includes religious and spiritual traditions as part of its cultural commonsense evaluation. The dataset guidelines explicitly encouraged categories like 'religions' and 'traditions,' and various individual language groups (such as Hebrew, Yoruba, Sinhala, and Bosnian) confirmed including items related to religious practices, festivals, and mythology in their respective subsets.
